g.text: Laptop TCP, HPS software and MMIO transport

g.text: Complete input reception precedes accelerator execution; the response carries both full outputs.

g.text: Board wall / thread timers enclose the frozen controller only. TCP input receipt and reply transmission are outside

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #9c7d3f

g.text: One request per connection; bounded requests served serially. Failed requests
end the service without automatic retry or MMIO recovery.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d78a8

g.text: No FPGA DMA, reserved DDR ring or UDP path is active. Reference gold is not
uploaded to the FPGA. This view is descriptive, not deployment guidance.
